title: Humanities
lead: One story, told in order. Part one builds the stage: the Universe, the Sun and its planets, the restless Earth, the five oceans and the seven continents. Part two brings on the players: the first people, Egypt, China and the Inca. Nine units, fifty-two numbered topics, and a short Portugal at this stage panel in every unit, so you always know what was happening on one Atlantic coast while the rest of the world got on with it.
bullets: Part one: the Universe, the Sun, the planets and the restless Earth
